title: Plan coverage and keep dispatch aligned

scenes.title: Plan coverage and keep dispatch aligned
scenes.narration: Welcome to Resgrid Academy. In this lesson, we will plan coverage and keep dispatch aligned. A paper duty schedule and a dispatch roster can drift apart, especially when members sign up or trade shifts. We will explain the features, the setup decisions, and a practical way to check the result.

scenes.title: A department scenario
scenes.narration: A career department sets up A, B and C shifts, and a volunteer department uses shift sign-ups for weekend duty crews. Shifts show who is on duty and can drive dispatch, so calls page the people who are actually working. The examples in this series use a fictional department and are teaching scenarios, not default settings.

scenes.title: Shifts
scenes.narration: Shifts. Shift schedules, sign-ups and trades. Create your shifts, assign groups and members, and decide whether dispatch follows shifts. Availability also depends on Shifts. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: Calendar
scenes.narration: Calendar. The department calendar for meetings, events and training nights. Add recurring meetings and training nights. Availability also depends on Calendar. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: New Calendar Event
scenes.narration: New Calendar Event. Add an event to the department calendar. Have your rotation or duty schedule, and decide whether dispatch should follow shifts. Availability also depends on Calendar. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: Workshifts
scenes.narration: Workshifts. Repeating work schedules for staff. Have your rotation or duty schedule, and decide whether dispatch should follow shifts. Availability also depends on Shifts. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: Configure one useful workflow
scenes.narration: For the training scenario, work in this order. Step 1. Create an assigned or signup shift with groups and staffing needs. Step 2. Have demo members sign up or complete a trade where supported. Step 3. Review whether dispatch follows groups or shifts and confirm the calendar time zone.

scenes.title: Verify the result
scenes.narration: Now verify the result. Compare the scheduled roster with the people dispatch would include at the selected time. Check trade completion and the visible duty coverage. A common problem to watch for: A calendar event is not automatically a duty assignment. Shift dispatch behavior must be reviewed on Dispatch Settings.

scenes.title: Try it with your department
scenes.narration: Your practice task is simple. Schedule a weekend duty crew, change one assignment, and verify the expected roster. Track unfilled slots and unresolved trades. Record the result, who owns the follow-up, and when it should be reviewed.
